narr: A large thunderstorm complex tracked southeast from Kentucky and Middle Tennessee into East Tennessee during the late afternoon and evening hours. Wind damage was reported across the northern Cumberland Plateau and the central Tennessee Valley. Flash flooding near Pittman Center and in the Greenbriar area of the National Park.
ev: Flash flooding in Greenbriar Campground with multiple people stranded. About 20 parked vehicles washed downstream. Downstream from the Campground, Emerts Cove Road flooded, with bridges inundated and dwellings taking water. Evacuations took place along Pittman Center Road. Upstream from the Campground, significant damage occurred to Greenbriar Road in the National Park.
